multiObsMethod.title: Multi obs method
multiObsMethod.description:
* **""**: no multiobs 
 * **"full"**: giving one spectra by observation to the lib 
 * **"merge"**: merge observations in a single spectra

lambdaRange.title: Lambda range in Angstroms. Is an array (range) for mono obs, and a dictionary of ranges for multiobs.

anyOf.title: Dictionnary of lambda ranges
anyOf.description: each key corresponds to one observation

airVacuumMethod.title: Air vaccum method
airVacuumMethod.description: Method to apply for the air to vacuum wavelength conversion when reading input spectrum. Currently "default" method corresponds to morton2000

lineMeasRunMode.title: Run mode for line measurement
lineMeasRunMode.description:
Option to run line measurement per spectrum on models : 
 * **"all"**: all models 
 * **"classif"**: only the classified one

extremaRedshiftSeparation.title: Extrema redshift separation
extremaRedshiftSeparation.description: Minimal distance between two extrema (currently not used with linemodel)

smoothWidth.title: smooth width
smoothWidth.description: Number of elements over which to apply spectrum continuum smoothing (half kernel width).

autoCorrectInput.title: Wether to correct input spectrum
autoCorrectInput.description: Wether to apply a flux/noise correction on input spectrum

spectrumModels.title: Spectrum models
spectrumModels.description: Names of the spectrum models to process. All mentioned models must have dedicated spectrumModel_<name> section.

photometryTransmissionDir.title: Photometry transmission directory
photometryTransmissionDir.description: Path containing the photometric transmission bands (one per file). If relative, path is relative to calibration directory. Mandatory if enablePhotometry is set to True. Raises a warning if present but enablePhotometry is set to False.

photometryBand.title: Photometry band
photometryBand.description: List of the band names to use. The name is contained in each band file, and should have the same name than the photometric data contained in the input spectra

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: List (or for multiobs a dictionary of List) of filters to apply for pixel selection on spectra.

anyOf.title: dictionnary of filters list
anyOf.description: each key corresponds to one observation

additionalCols.title: Additional columns
additionalCols.description: List of spectrum columns to take into account addtionally to "Wave" "Flux" "Err". Ex: ["Flags"] If you want to filter incoming spectra depending on column a column named Flags

ebmv.title: b minus v
ebmv.description: b minus v: color ratio, used to calculate ISM extinction curve.

nbSamplesMin.title: Minimum number of samples in a spectrum

secondPassAfterClassification.title: Second pass after classification
secondPassAfterClassification.description: Run second pass only on classified spectrum model
